text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp had arrived. There 
were three things to be done to address 
the issues weighing on Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First: Having Sirius Symboli talk with 
Symboli Rudolf, and coming to understand 
her own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second was improving her own 
abilities. And the third was deepening the 
bond of trust between Sirius Symboli and 
her Trainer.
